APP.TITLE: Welcome to our app
APP.DESCRIPTION: This is an example of localization.

LOGIN.TITLE: Login
LOGIN.SUBTITLE: Enter your credentials to access your account

LOGOUT.TITLE: Logout
LOGOUT.MESSAGE: Logging you out of the system...

REGISTER.TAGLINE: Create an account to start shopping
REGISTER.TITLE: Create an account
REGISTER.SUBTITLE: Enter your details to create a new account

FORGOT_PASSWORD.TITLE: Forgot password
FORGOT_PASSWORD.SUBTITLE: Enter your account email and we will send you a link to reset your password.
FORGOT_PASSWORD.SENT: If an account with that email exists, we have sent a password reset link.
FORGOT_PASSWORD.DEV_HINT: In development the email is written to the backend log.

RESET_PASSWORD.TITLE: New password
RESET_PASSWORD.SUBTITLE: Account: {{email}}
RESET_PASSWORD.SUCCESS: Your password has been changed. Log in with your new password.
RESET_PASSWORD.INVALID_LINK: The password reset link is invalid or has expired.

FIELDS.PASSWORD_HINT: At least {{min}} characters, including a letter and a digit

PROFILE.TITLE: My profile
PROFILE.DATA_SUBTITLE: Name and delivery address for your orders
PROFILE.EMAIL_HINT: The email cannot be changed here.
PROFILE.ADDRESS_HINT: Street and number, e.g. Maršala Tita 1

CHANGE_PASSWORD.TITLE: Change password
CHANGE_PASSWORD.SUBTITLE: After the change you will be signed out on your other devices.
CHANGE_PASSWORD.SUCCESS: Your password has been changed. Your other devices have been signed out.

LANDING.HERO_DESCRIPTION: Log in to access your account. Amounts can be converted to other currencies using the exchange rate list.

CURRENCY.KM_NOTE: Orders are charged in KM (BAM); the amount in another currency is for information only.

CONVERTER.TITLE: Currency converter
CONVERTER.INTRO: The server converts the amount using the exchange rate list; for a past date the rate valid at that time is used.

HOME.TITLE: Welcome
HOME.DESCRIPTION: Here you can edit your profile.

ADMIN_SETTINGS.TITLE: Settings
ADMIN_SETTINGS.EMPTY: Application settings go here (e.g. company details, default currency, business rules). Personal data and password are on the “My profile” page.

EXCHANGE_RATES.TITLE: Exchange rates
EXCHANGE_RATES.SUBTITLE: How many KM one unit of a currency is worth. A rate is valid from its date until the next rate of the same currency.
EXCHANGE_RATES.DELETE_MESSAGE: Are you sure you want to delete this {{code}} rate? Conversions for that period will use the previous rate.

SPECIALIZATIONS.TITLE: Specializations
SPECIALIZATIONS.SUBTITLE: Dentist specializations (e.g. orthodontics, oral surgery).
SPECIALIZATIONS.NAME: Name
SPECIALIZATIONS.DELETE_MESSAGE: Are you sure you want to delete the specialization "{{name}}"?

SERVICE_CATEGORIES.TITLE: Service categories
SERVICE_CATEGORIES.SUBTITLE: Categories of dental services (e.g. prevention, prosthetics).
SERVICE_CATEGORIES.NAME: Name
SERVICE_CATEGORIES.DELETE_MESSAGE: Are you sure you want to delete the category "{{name}}"?

MESSAGES.DELETE_CONFIRM: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"?
MESSAGES.UNSAVED_CHANGES: You have unsaved changes. Do you want to continue?
MESSAGES.ERROR_GENERIC: An error occurred. Please try again.
MESSAGES.ERROR_NETWORK: Network error. Please check your internet connection.

VALIDATION.EMAIL: Please enter a valid email address
VALIDATION.PHONE: Please enter a valid phone number
VALIDATION.PASSWORD: Password must be at least {{min}} characters long and contain a letter and a digit
VALIDATION.URL_OR_PATH: Enter an https:// address or an app route starting with "/"
VALIDATION.DATE_RANGE: The end must be after the start

ERRORS.GENERIC: An error occurred. Please try again.
ERRORS.NETWORK: Network error. Please check your connection.
ERRORS.UNAUTHORIZED: You are not authorized to perform this action.
ERRORS.LOGIN_REQUIRED: Your session has expired or you are not logged in. Please log in again.
ERRORS.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
ERRORS.SERVER_ERROR: Server error. Please try again later.
ERRORS.CONFLICT: This action conflicts with existing data.
ERRORS.VALIDATION: Please check the form for errors.
